title: AGI / Aegis / Aggreko / Angelica / Autogrill / Farmer Mac / Allergan — Claim Identity, Timing and Merger Arbitrage V9

notes: Raw Short -> actual Long/Long-spread corrections: Aggreko 2014, Farmer Mac 2009 and Pfizer/Allergan 2016.
AGN.PA 2016 is not a simple Allergan short; it is the Pfizer/Allergan leg of a broader merger-arbitrage basket/pair strategy.
Farmer Mac 2009 is the only Batch 72 idea with a usable source-DB horizon performance row: 1Y +64.0%, 2Y +116.1%, 3Y +211.7%, 5Y +295.4%.
Alamos Gold 2022 delivered a very strong stock outcome, but the original 2025 AISC ~$800 and Lynn Lake 2027 production schedules did not occur as forecast.
Aegis Logistics materially expanded LPG terminal throughput and earnings; exact VIC-day stock return is not reconstructed.
Aggreko was taken private at 880p in 2021 versus the 1,527p VIC entry, before dividends.
Angelica sold Life Uniform below the author's expected proceeds and was later acquired for $22 cash/share; exact 2003 entry return is not reconstructed.
Autogrill's 2023 Dufry combination provided a €6.33 cash alternative versus the 2013 €6.02 entry; the original 24-30 month catalyst timing failed.
Allergan 2015 Actavis and 2019 AbbVie merger arbitrages closed at stated terms; exact hedged IRRs are not asserted without actual hedge fills.
Pfizer/Allergan terminated after the April 2016 U.S. Treasury anti-inversion rules; the break is treated as a failure of the AGN/PFE arb leg rather than the entire author's basket.
Allergan 2018 fundamental Long ended via AbbVie takeout at a value below the original $240-$270 standalone target.

batch_lessons: Mining security returns can be excellent even when original cost and schedule forecasts miss; operating accuracy and stock outcome should be scored separately.
Infrastructure compounders should be evaluated on throughput, utilization and incremental ROIC rather than announced capacity alone.
Historical high ROCE is not automatically a durable moat in capital-intensive rental businesses.
A corporate action can validate an asset but still produce a poor IRR if it occurs too late or below the original target.
Crisis financial analysis should isolate core recurring earnings from already-recognized toxic-asset losses.
Merger-arbitrage positions must be stored as spreads or pair trades rather than reduced to a raw Long/Short flag.
Mixed cash/stock mergers require explicit hedge ratios and cannot be evaluated from target price charts.
Tax-driven cross-border mergers require explicit policy-regime and tax-law-change analysis.
A strategic takeout is only a partial fundamental-thesis success if the consideration is materially below the original intrinsic-value target.
The same ticker can represent fundamentally different claims across vintages; Allergan 2015, 2016, 2018 and 2019 are four distinct investments.
